title: Custom fixtures
summary: LoginPage is provided in pages/LoginPage.ts (read-only). Create a loginPage fixture with test.extend and use it in two tests.
why: Fixtures are Playwright's dependency injection: setup + teardown live in one place, tests just ask for what they need ({ loginPage }), and only the fixtures a test uses are created.
hints: import { test as base, expect } from '@playwright/test';
Code after await use(...) is teardown.
pitfalls: Calling new LoginPage(page) in every test instead of using the fixture.
teachAlong: Cause: the fixture builds LoginPage and navigates.
Effect: tests start at the action, not the setup.
Gate: requires test.extend and a test that asks for { loginPage }.

requires.reason: Create the fixture with base.extend<{ loginPage: LoginPage }>({ loginPage: async ({ page }, use) => { … } }).

requires.name: loginPage
requires.reason: Use the fixture: write your tests as async ({ loginPage }) => { … } instead of building LoginPage by hand.

mutants.reason: the dashboard greets the user as 'Guest'
